points.description: Names most of the four types: run-of-river plant, storage (reservoir) plant, cascade plant, pumped storage plant. About three of the four, in any wording, earns full marks.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only one or two of the types are correctly named.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) if the student names at least three of the four types: run-of-river, storage/reservoir, cascade, pumped storage. Give 1 mark for one or two correct types. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers, such as types based on head (high, medium, low) only. Wrong extra items do not cost marks.
